Total Solar Eclipse Visible Globally, Not in India; Safety Gear Demand Surges

A total solar eclipse occurred on August 12, with the Moon completely obscuring the Sun for a period, causing day to briefly turn into night in affected regions. The event was visible across parts of the globe, though not in India. In Spain, where temperatures neared 40C and wildfire threats were present, authorities implemented safety plans for the eclipse. Demand for certified eclipse viewing glasses surged in Spain, leading to stock shortages.
